_note: The decision point registry. A decision requested at an unregistered point is refused as a conformance failure rather than evaluated against an assumed shape (cap-policy contract, register_decision_point; F-b3-09). resource_schema is the declared shape checked before evaluation; cap-document-validation owns the real dialect. Proposed: these three points are this repo's design, not a recorded fact.

admission.entry.taken_at: admission, when a unit of work enters through any of the four entries

dispatch.tool_call.taken_at: dispatch, before the first metered call of the unit of work

dispatch.data_query.taken_at: dispatch, over a free-form document rather than a typed resource
